jobs.title: Director of Engineering Platform Services
jobs.description:
Job Title:
Director of Engineering Platform Services
Location:
Remote
Salary:
$200,000-$225,000

About the Technology Company / The Opportunity:

Join a forward-thinking organization in the technology, information and media industry that is using automation, data, and scalable digital platforms to connect consumers with products and experiences. As Director of Engineering Platform Services, you will build a new platform organization from the ground up, defining its technical vision, architecture, engineering standards, and operating model. This highly hands-on leadership opportunity will enable multiple brands and businesses through reliable, reusable services supporting high-volume B2C applications and future B2B capabilities.

Responsibilities:

Define and execute the long-term Platform Services strategy while balancing foundational investments with evolving product and business priorities.
Build and scale a new platform organization, establishing architecture, processes, standards, and reusable technical capabilities.
Design and evolve scalable services, APIs, integration patterns, and microservices for multiple brands, products, and internal and external consumers.
Provide hands-on technical leadership across system design, architecture reviews, implementation decisions, and platform-wide risk management.
Partner with Product, Engineering, Design, CloudOps, and business stakeholders to translate priorities into executable roadmaps.
Hire, mentor, and develop high-performing engineering teams and technical leaders while improving developer productivity and engineering effectiveness.
Drive operational excellence through standards for reliability, performance, observability, security, automated testing, resiliency, and disaster recovery.
Lead incident response, establish engineering and operational metrics, and champion AI-assisted development and engineering automation.

Must-Have Skills:

12+ years of technical leadership experience supporting large-scale, enterprise-level B2C applications.
8+ years of people management experience building, developing, and scaling engineering teams.
Demonstrated experience building or leading Platform Services or comparable shared platform organizations, preferably in a greenfield or early-stage environment.
Deep expertise in platform, service-oriented, microservices, distributed systems, and cloud-native architecture.
Strong API design and scalability experience, including secure APIs serving internal, external, public, and partner consumers.
Hands-on experience with asynchronous communication patterns, SQL and NoSQL databases, and high-traffic systems.
Proficiency designing and delivering cloud-native applications using GCP and/or AWS, DevOps, CI/CD, Kubernetes, Docker, and infrastructure as code.
Strong understanding of reliability, observability, security, performance engineering, automated testing, resiliency, high availability, and disaster recovery.
Bachelor’s degree in Computer Science, Engineering, or equivalent professional experience.

Nice-to-Have Skills:

Experience in travel technology, hospitality technology, hotel, lodging, accommodation, reservation, booking, or online travel marketplace platforms.
Experience supporting multi-brand, multi-product, enterprise-scale, high-volume consumer platforms.
Exposure to GraphQL, API gateways, API management platforms, event-driven architecture, and external API product strategy.
Experience expanding primarily B2C platform capabilities into B2B use cases.
Background introducing generative AI, AI-assisted development, engineering automation, or modern developer productivity tooling.
Experience establishing engineering KPIs, architectural decision records, operational metrics, and succession planning.
Knowledge of corporate IT policies, procedures, security standards, and compliance practices.

jobs.title: Vice President & Head of CRM Technology
jobs.description:
Job Title:
Vice President & Head of CRM Technology
Location:
On Site - New York, New York, United States
Salary:
$185,000-$200,000
Skills:
CRM, C#, .NET Core, SQL Server, Rest/Soap APIs, Bulk API, LWC, Flow/Process Automation, Salesforce data governance

About the Wireless Communication Company / The Opportunity:

Join a forward-thinking organization in the wireless communication industry, where innovative technology and data-driven solutions support critical customer and business operations. As Vice President & Head of CRM Technology, you will shape the strategy, architecture, and development of a strategic Salesforce CRM ecosystem while leading integration, data, and application initiatives across cloud and on-premise environments. This high-impact leadership opportunity combines hands-on technical influence with team development and close partnership with senior business stakeholders.

Responsibilities:

Own the strategic roadmap and technology vision for the CRM ecosystem, aligning technical execution with business priorities.
Direct the architecture, development, implementation, and delivery of CRM integration solutions across internal and external platforms.
Lead, mentor, and manage CRM developers while establishing standards for architecture, code quality, documentation, and delivery.
Serve as the primary technical stakeholder and escalation point for CRM initiatives across technology and business teams.
Design and build service-based solutions using Azure App Services, Azure SQL Database, Microsoft Fabric, and related cloud technologies.
Guide Salesforce platform enhancements and ensure effective release management, environment governance, and CI/CD practices.
Partner with business users to define requirements, prioritize work, resolve application issues, and address data discrepancies.
Communicate complex technical concepts clearly to senior stakeholders and promote sustainable, user-focused business solutions.

Must-Have Skills:

Bachelor’s degree in Information Technology or a related field.
10+ years of experience in CRM or data application development, including deep hands-on expertise with C#, Python, .NET Core, and SQL Server.
Experience defining technology strategy and priorities with senior business stakeholders.
Proven experience leading or mentoring development teams with accountability for technical direction and delivery.
Strong SQL expertise, including advanced querying, window functions, CTEs, pivoting, and slowly changing dimensions.
Strong knowledge of ETL tools, data integration patterns, and application lifecycle management.
Experience designing and reviewing Salesforce integrations using REST/SOAP APIs, Bulk API, Platform Events, and Change Data Capture.
Strong knowledge of Apex, Lightning Web Components, and Flow/Process Automation sufficient to guide and review development work.
Experience with Salesforce data governance, including sharing and security models, field-level security, data quality, and deduplication strategies.
Familiarity with Salesforce release management and DevOps practices, including sandboxes, change sets, and CI/CD.
Excellent written and verbal communication, customer service, prioritization, vendor management, and stakeholder engagement skills.
Understanding of portfolio management processes, including Positions and Transactions, and their relationship to CRM objects such as Accounts, Contacts, and Opportunities.

Nice-to-Have Skills:

Experience with microservices and service-oriented architecture.
Experience with Microsoft Fabric, Azure DataBricks, Snowflake, or comparable data platforms.
Experience with Azure DevOps and CI/CD implementation.
Relevant Salesforce certifications or Salesforce administration experience.
Recent experience in asset management, investment management, or hedge fund environments.
Knowledge of master data management concepts and enterprise data governance.
Experience with Python and data manipulation libraries.
Experience using job scheduling platforms such as JAMS, ActiveBatch, AutoSys, or equivalent tools.
Strong technical writing and documentation skills.
Demonstrated commitment to inclusive collaboration and respect for diverse perspectives.
